description: Customer requests by email and phone; distributor price and stock checks; quotes and sales orders in the accounting and inventory SaaS
mtd_rto_rpo_drivers: About 60 quotes and 40 orders a month (about $720 of receipts per business day); small-business customers buy elsewhere if a quote takes more than 2 days; RPO set by the accounting SaaS vendor's daily backup (24 hours)
manual_workaround: Quote from distributor portal pricing in a spreadsheet and email a PDF; enter sales orders after recovery
dependent_third_parties: Accounting SaaS vendor; email provider; distributors A and B
dependent_people_or_facilities: Owner (single point of failure); home office

description: Purchase orders and drop shipments through distributor portals; marketplace and broker buys; receiving checks and stock counts in the garage cabinet
mtd_rto_rpo_drivers: Drop shipments must be placed the day an order is confirmed to meet promised dates; receiving checks are the only point where counterfeit or tampered stock can be stopped (P01 R-001)
manual_workaround: Phone orders to the distributor account representatives; hold all marketplace and broker purchases until systems are back
dependent_third_parties: Distributors A and B; marketplace; brokers; parcel carriers
dependent_people_or_facilities: Owner (single point of failure); garage stock cabinet

business_process: DoD staging and delivery for the prime
description: Firmware updates to the prime's specified version; asset tags; serial-to-tag-to-building spreadsheet; kitting; delivery to the prime's staging warehouse
mtd_rto_rpo_drivers: About 2 purchase orders and 30 devices a month (23% of receipts); the prime's building schedule allows about 3 business days of slack; the serial-to-tag spreadsheet is the record the prime relies on and contains FCI; losing it means relabeling and rescanning every device. RPO of 8 hours is not supported today: the spreadsheet is often saved only on the laptop (P01 R-014)
manual_workaround: Tell the prime's subcontracts manager the same day; stage from printed tag sheets and record serials on paper; enter them in the spreadsheet after recovery
dependent_third_parties: Prime contractor; distributor A; OEM firmware download sites
dependent_people_or_facilities: Owner (only staging technician); garage bench and cabinet

description: Invoices with hosted payment links; check and ACH deposits; card and wire payments to distributors, marketplace sellers, and brokers
mtd_rto_rpo_drivers: Cash flow: about $3,500 invoiced per week; distributors allow 30-day terms; customers pay within 30 days; wire fraud risk is higher than downtime risk (P01 R-002)
manual_workaround: Invoice from a spreadsheet template; call customers for payment; pay distributors by phone on terms; no new wire instructions accepted during an outage
dependent_third_parties: Accounting SaaS vendor; bank; invoicing payment page provider

description: Troubleshooting calls; returns (RMAs) and warranty claims through OEM partner portals; trade-ins
mtd_rto_rpo_drivers: Customers with a failed switch or access point need a replacement within 2 to 3 days; OEM advance replacement handles most failures
manual_workaround: Customers call OEM support directly with their serial numbers; owner ships a replacement from stock
